title: VTA Witness — Present — payload
description: A client hands its VTA the witness's answer to the session it opened; the VTA verifies that the answer is the witness's own, builds the presentations bound to its challenge and domain, and returns the witness/session/submit document, signed as the relationship DID, for the client to send.

response.description: The witness/session/0.1 #response the witness returned, exactly as received, under the witness's proof.

document.description: The witness/session/submit/0.1 document, on the session's thread, issued and signed by relationshipDid and addressed to the witness, carrying the relationship presentation in `vp` and, under the member link, the member presentation in the carriage the witness accepts. For the client to send from relationshipDid unaltered.
